name: ChirpStack LoRaWAN
description: Self-hosted LoRaWAN Network Server - ChirpStack 4.19.1 (SQLite) plus Gateway Bridge 4.1.2. Runs entirely on your LAN with no cloud dependency.

ports_description.8080/tcp: ChirpStack web UI (host port 8090 - 8080 commonly collides with UniFi)
ports_description.3001/tcp: LoRaWAN Basic Station endpoint - point your gateway's LNS URI here
